name: 74HC08
description: クワッド 2入力 AND (DIP-14)。スイッチで作った簡易モデル (遅延なし)。入力のしきい値は電源の半分、2〜6V で動作

sim.name: 74HC08
sim.text:
* 74HC08 behavioural model: CMOS gates made of voltage-controlled switches (no propagation delay).
.subckt 74HC08 a1 b1 y1 a2 b2 y2 gnd y3 a3 b3 y4 a4 b4 vcc
Rh1 vcc hv 100k
Rh2 hv gnd 100k
S1 vcc g1 hv a1 SWPA
S2 vcc g1 hv b1 SWPA
S3 g1 q2 a1 hv SWNS
S4 q2 gnd b1 hv SWNS
S5 vcc y1 hv g1 SWPA
S6 y1 gnd g1 hv SWNA
S7 vcc g3 hv a2 SWPA
S8 vcc g3 hv b2 SWPA
S9 g3 q4 a2 hv SWNS
S10 q4 gnd b2 hv SWNS
S11 vcc y2 hv g3 SWPA
S12 y2 gnd g3 hv SWNA
S13 vcc g5 hv a3 SWPA
S14 vcc g5 hv b3 SWPA
S15 g5 q6 a3 hv SWNS
S16 q6 gnd b3 hv SWNS
S17 vcc y3 hv g5 SWPA
S18 y3 gnd g5 hv SWNA
S19 vcc g7 hv a4 SWPA
S20 vcc g7 hv b4 SWPA
S21 g7 q8 a4 hv SWNS
S22 q8 gnd b4 hv SWNS
S23 vcc y4 hv g7 SWPA
S24 y4 gnd g7 hv SWNA
.model SWPA SW(RON=80 ROFF=1G VT=0 VW=0.1)
.model SWPS SW(RON=40 ROFF=1G VT=0 VW=0.1)
.model SWNA SW(RON=40 ROFF=1G VT=0 VW=0.1)
.model SWNS SW(RON=20 ROFF=1G VT=0 VW=0.1)
.model SWT SW(RON=100 ROFF=1G VT=0 VW=0.05)
.model SWF SW(RON=1 ROFF=1G VT=0 VW=0.1)
.ends 74HC08
